name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 5px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. This keeps the ring crisp and unmistakable for keyboard users while meeting WCAG’s 7:1 requirement for small text. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but it avoids blending into backgrounds or shrinking on high-DPI screens.

name: Reader
text: The 5px ring at 7:1 still risks crowding small interactive elements on mobile—especially when users zoom or have larger touch targets. A 3px ring at 6:1 keeps the focus indicator visible without stealing space; test with real users at 200% zoom to settle it.
